CheckTitle: VM Guest Configuration extension is installed
Description: Verify that Virtual Machines have the Guest Configuration extension installed for compliance management.
Risk: Without the Guest Configuration extension, in-guest configuration policies cannot be audited or enforced.

Code.CLI:
az vm extension set --publisher Microsoft.GuestConfiguration --name ConfigurationforWindows --vm-name <vm-name> --resource-group <resource-group>
# For Linux:
az vm extension set --publisher Microsoft.GuestConfiguration --name ConfigurationforLinux --vm-name <vm-name> --resource-group <resource-group>

Recommendation.Text: Install the Guest Configuration extension on your virtual machines.
